## Posts

### [When is a genetic association real?](posts/genetic-association-real.qmd)

A field note on why odds ratios alone are not enough, and how uncertainty and sample size shape interpretation.

**Related concepts:** Odds Ratio, Confidence Interval, Sample Size

### [Building a Hot Ones lineup from our local hot sauce shop](posts/hot-ones-lineup/index.qmd)

A side project in Python: parsing a store catalog into a table, matching sauces to the show's ten wings by Scoville rating, and asking whether heat or brand sets the price of a bottle.

**Category:** Cross-Discipline Curiosity
**Related concepts:** web scraping, log scales, Spearman correlation, R² and adjusted R²
**Code and data:** [folder on GitHub](https://github.com/paola-arguello/paola-arguello.github.io/tree/main/crosswalk/posts/hot-ones-lineup)
